This cleanser made monumental improvements to my skin! I am truly so impressed. I see so many reviews on here complaining this broke them out or dried out their skin. What they may not know is that you WILL break out for the first few weeks that you are using any type of active ingredient. In fact, it means the product is working like it should. The salicylic acid is working hard to bring all that gunk underneath your skin to the surface, which ultimately results in fresh and healthy new skin. For the first three weeks I used this, I noticed tiny bumps all over my cheeks. In the weeks that followed, the bumps disappeared completely. I used to struggle with acne, and I truly believe this is the product that changed that for me. I no longer get breakouts, with the exception of the occasional pimple here and there. I have been consistently using this cleanser every single day, following it up with the Anua Heartleaf 77% toner, the Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow toner, and the Face Reality "clearderma" moisturizer, and my skin has never received as many compliments as it does now!

This is my go to cleanser for my acne prone, combination skin. I've tried using other salicylic acid cleansers but typically salicylic causes my skin to become sensitized while benzoyl peroxide based cleansers dry my pores out. This formulation is perfect for providing a deeper clean and encouraging cellular turnover without irritation or redness. Some skincare products tend to smell very fragrant or harsh but this cleanser is neither and a little goes a long way. The texture is slightly gel like and doesn't foam up in excess. When using this cleanser I'm able to reduce my skincare routine and I've been able to reduce usage of prescribed products that used to cause severe irritation.

You will purge the first few weeks which is completely normal and then afterwards it will do what it supposed to do. No skin care product is immediate and salicylic acid is supposed to work after 8 to 12 weeks. It does what it supposed to do.
